name: hh-farm
description: A cozy browser-first 2D farming game built with Phaser and TypeScript.

scripts.test:e2e: vite build --mode e2e && playwright test --grep-invert @production-loop && vite build && playwright test --grep @production-loop
scripts.check: npm run generate:maps && git diff --exit-code -- public/maps/farm-test.json && npm run generate:assets && git diff --exit-code -- public/assets/generated && npm run validate:art-pack && npm run validate:assets && npm run validate:content && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:run && npm run build && npm run verify:production-bundle
